response.original_title: Art in Motion: Dive into Skinny Fish
response.overview: In this immersive documentary, Ange pushes open the doors of the studio to discover how the official teaser for this landmark project was made. Captivated from the very first moment by the poetry of this aquatic world and its historic significance for Cambodian cinema, he sets out to meet the artists, illustrators, and technicians shaping this work.
response.title: Art in Motion: Dive into Skinny Fish
